requirements.quote: Compress the `/home/user/hardening` directory into a single gzip-compressed tar archive stored in `/home/user/archives/hardening_backup.tar.gz`.

Produce a plain-text logfile named `/home/user/compression_report.log` containing EXACTLY the following four newline-separated key=value pairs (no extra spaces, no blank lines, no surrounding quotes):

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
s = open('/home/user/compression_report.log').read()
exp = 'ARCHIVE_PATH=/home/user/archives/hardening_backup.tar.gz\nFILES_IN_ARCHIVE=2\nRESTORE_DIR=/home/user/restore_test\nHASH_MATCH=OK'
sys.exit(0 if s in (exp, exp + '\n') else 1)
PYEOF
